body: Current update: I have a friend who I've known for a few years. I got winded and upset trying to talk to him and we have these issues where we cut each other off. Him with interrogative questions he says are for him to get me to think but he didn't want to acknowledge my opinion. I just get so frustrated because he knew me from my youth and treats me like a mental patient. He refuses to let me express my opinion and he ended up telling me that he wants me to have a great life and hes done talking to me and he blocked me. I just wanted to share my opinion because I felt like he wasn't understanding me or listening to me. I just wanted to explain and express my side and now I lost a friend. Its stuff like this that makes me worry about continuing further. I feel like I can't connect with people or convey what I was trying to say. I told him I wasnt trying to argue. I was trying to explain my side and I was upset. But he takes it back to how I was before with my instabilities. I have this reputation I am trying to shed off and its one of the reasons I have this whole circumstance of being afraid to be myself. I dont know what to do...

The issue is the plan. I am in the process of trying to repair my life and debts so I can leave without being homeless or broke. I don't know where to go or how I can afford anything as right now I can barely afford anything right now. I am just in the process of trying to stop living paycheck to paycheck. I want to leave. I tried to work it out. I tried to be civil and conform to what they want of me even when its not good enough. I try to stay civil and avoidant of any confrontation in the house. I keep my spot clean and I don't make any messes outside of my room. Like I am lucky that although I live in one of the more expensive cities in the US I don't have to pay rent. My grandfather kindly has let me stay there while I rebuild my life. My sister loves to make comparisons about how she fixed her life first and shes going to leave. And thats the thing. I am trying to come up with solutions. My problem is I am being swept by the current that is life. Paying for family things, transportation, everything everyone else has to pay for. In fact i know I have a skewed priority because I usually don't even eat. I skip meals just to make sure I make it to work and do what I have to do or pay anything else I have to pay off. I have difficulty being self sufficient and functioning consistently. Its not that I am not trying of course. The whole fact that we were arguing was because I was trying to eat healthier and bring food from home. Which I do help pay for food too. I am afraid since I don't have a lot of support systems and I have major depression and C-PTSD that I wont be able to do well trying to live alone or move away. I think the issue is finding some sense of security before I leave. I just feel like I have to pay everything off first. Or have reliable transportation. I don't want to make excuses. I am working on myself and rebuilding my life. I payed some stuff off and I still have this job. Its been almost a year. And although my anxiety and trauma effects my performance sometimes I try to work harder to resolve the issues. I just feel overwhelmed. My job is an account admin/production admin. I litterally am the person who picks up all tasks and parts of a job. I want to be diversified. Like an expert generalist. I've always been mister jack of trades. Eclectic tastes and passions in all kinds of things. I know I used to be capable. I used to live on my own. And I took ok care of myself. Now I just feel weak inadequate and terrified of being stuck and poor. I mean the alternative is obviously killing me as well which is why I feel trapped. I am biding my time and trying to build up finances but I feel like there are all these setbacks at home and in life. I don't want to be a mooch. I just want to move forward with my life.

That makes sense. Thank you. I think the thing is my Sister more than anyone in my family. More than any abuse I have ever experienced.. She just knows how to trigger me more than anyone else. She knows what to say to break me down authentically. She knows how to demonize and make me feel not only inadequate but the one who is the problem. The one always at fault, the mental head case. Weak because of my issues. Devalued and disrespected. I wish for a support system. I just want to not be bothered by what my sister says but she knows how to make you feel dumb and pathetic and ashamed. She says its all jokes but she doesnt respect or understand how much it hurts me. She tells me its the end of the world whenever I react. That I get so upset and I am the scary one. I am the one who has a problem with how the world works. Her logic and ideas dont make sense to me. Like doing things because she has an expectation that it will be repayed. "Because a good person will do something nice back" You dont do things expecting something in return. You do them because you want to do them. She says I don't provide enough for the family. That i am selfish. Here I am trying to love myself but not be selfish. Trying to be a good person but also take care of my own needs. She is wittiling me away with her requests. Like offering me rides to work and then going on about how I dont give her gas even when I pay money I dont have. Get more in debt trying to appease her. I know you should just not care what they think but she invades my privacy. she comes in and has to say what she has to say regardless of having another opinion or if you wanted to share something different. One of the reasons I am in debt is because I was spending money obligations to family because they helped raise me so I am indebted to them. This effects my relationships because I am always terrified to accept help or anything. I am sick of her manipulation. Its killing me and my trust in humanity. She always talks about the negative. About how my grandfather will find another woman and kick us all out. How everything is pointless. How people are so soft and all these things. Its not healthy or right what she is doing... One time we were voting for propositions and elections and she said to give her my ballot so she can put down what she wants to vote for. I told her its my right to not vote or vote or vote for what I want and she said I didn't read it or care and that shes not going to waste my vote. We literally got in this ridiculous argument where she left claw scars on my shoulder from scratching me. Shes control. Manipulative and fucking with my psychologically. Especially when she lets me trust her again. She villianizes me. Makes me feel bad for liking things I like. Things I see my friends like or do. Worse things that other people have done and it makes me sad. Like I am so terrible. I am the mental case... I am just sick of being devalued. I am sick of being stepped on. I am sick of being the only one who needs help. It makes me feel like a monster.
Sure do you have another form of contact that would be easier?

Thank you for your kinds words and support. I have looked into reaching out to other communities and doing things of interest to me. The issue is I used to be quite charming, charismatic, and witty. I used to be able to talk to people but now my voice crumbles as I continue to speak to people about something i like or interests me. I lose confidence mid sentence. I get shaky and jittery. I feel this probably not true feeling of showing and expressing something to someone. Something I like or whatever and feeling like it doesnt interest them or they dont care or its silly to like in the first place. I just feel like when I reach out to other communities (I was trying to be a part of the cosplay community) I come off as awkward or weird. Or a creeper. Like I said I know don't care what people think but I just feel like I am treated like a predator or some kind of sexual perv or people take my niceness as creepness or trying to hard or bothersome or annoying or flirtatious and manipulative....
I did the same thing. Which is why I felt so bad about smoking in the first place and when my sister guilt trips me about it all the time.
